summary: Dashboard charts look broken in Excel: titles over the plot, duplicate $0/$1 axis labels on an empty workbook, rotated month labels running into the legend, and charts overlapping each other.

required_changes.change: Chart titles sit above the plot area (title overlay off), never on top of the bars or gridlines.
required_changes.reason: A title printed over the gridlines looks broken in listing images and on the buyer's screen.
required_changes.acceptance: Every chart's XML has <c:overlay val="0"/> on its title; the rendered PNG shows the title clear of the plot.

required_changes.change: Month axes use Jan-Dec labels with no rotation, and the legend sits where it cannot collide with axis labels.
required_changes.reason: Rotated full month names collide with the bottom legend and December is clipped.
required_changes.acceptance: Month-axis labels are 3 characters or fewer, label rotation is 0, and no legend is at the bottom.

required_changes.change: Value axes have a fixed minimum (0, unless the chart must show losses), a fixed major unit and a currency number format.
required_changes.reason: On an empty workbook Excel auto-scales to 0-1 and shows $0 $0 $1 $1, which looks like a bug.
required_changes.acceptance: Every value axis has majorUnit and numFmt set (and min, unless the spec allows negatives); the empty template renders $0, $500, ...

required_changes.change: Size and place the charts so none overlap and all fit at 100% zoom on a 1920 px screen, inside the Dashboard print area.
required_changes.reason: Chart 1 ran into chart 3, and the Dashboard needed sideways scrolling.
required_changes.acceptance: Chart anchors do not overlap, every chart lies inside the print area, and the right edge is at most 1840 px.

findings.issue: Chart titles overlap the plot area and gridlines.
Empty-data value axes show duplicate labels ($0 $0 $1 $1) on all three charts.
Rotated month labels collide with the legend; December is clipped.
Charts overflow their area and overlap each other.
